name: nodetool
title_zh: 开源、Agent 优先的创意工作流画布
tagline_zh: 把 AI 当同事而不是工具：在可视化节点图上编排多智能体协作，让每个创意步骤都可回溯、可复用、可版本化。
tagline_en: Treat AI as a teammate, not a tool: orchestrate multi-agent workflows on a visual node graph where every creative.
why_zh: 节点即函数、连线即数据流，Agent 作为一等公民嵌入画布。比 LangChain 更直观。
why_en: Nodes are functions, edges are data flow, and agents are first-class citizens on the canvas. More intuitive than LangChain, more.
limit_zh: 只覆盖创意生成与编排层，不含模型训练/微调；需自行配置 LLM API 密钥；复杂多模态任务需熟悉其 Python 节。
limit_en: Covers creative generation & orchestration only, no model training/fine-tuning; requires your own LLM API keys; complex multimodal tasks need Python.
